/**
 * Build + render script for "__TITLE__". GENERATED by scripts/new-video.ts.
 * Edit the authored scenes below for your topic, then run:
 *
 *   npx tsx scripts/build-__ID__.ts stills
 *   npx tsx --env-file=.env scripts/build-__ID__.ts draft vivibe
 *   npx tsx --env-file=.env scripts/build-__ID__.ts full  vivibe
 *
 * Current authoring rules: see AI_CONTRACT.md and
 * docs/current/authoring-contract.md. Starter scenes are raw JSX/CSS/SVG,
 * deterministic, and import only the authored-scene whitelist.
 */
import {
  scaffoldVideoProject, renderProject, admitProjectScenes, loadManifestAsSpec,
  synthesizeNarration, lockSpec, renderSceneStills, generateAuthoredEntry, remotionAppRoot,
} from "../packages/pipeline/src/index.js";
import { projectPaths, writeJson } from "../packages/pipeline/src/store/store.js";
import { writeAuthoredScene } from "../packages/pipeline/src/authoring/manifest.js";

const ID = "__ID__";
const TARGET_SECONDS = 90 as const;

// --- Authored scenes (one module each). Replace these starters with bespoke,
//     topic-specific scenes. Keep each scene focused on one visual idea. ---

const STATEMENT = `import React from "react";
import { AbsoluteFill, interpolate, useCurrentFrame } from "remotion";
import { z } from "zod";
import { registerComponent, type SceneComponentProps } from "@motionreal/compositions";

const DISPLAY = "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif";
const COLORS = {
  bg: "#0A1020",
  panel: "#111827",
  fg: "#F6F8FB",
  muted: "#AAB4C0",
  accent: "#51E1A7",
  line: "#28324A",
};

export const schema = z.object({
  meta: z.string().optional(),
  callout: z.string().min(1),
  detail: z.string().optional(),
  footer: z.string().optional(),
});
type P = z.infer<typeof schema>;

const Scene: React.FC<SceneComponentProps<P>> = ({ headline, eyebrow, props }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const enter = interpolate(frame, [0, 18], [0, 1], { extrapolateLeft: "clamp", extrapolateRight: "clamp" });
  const sweep = interpolate(frame, [8, 42], [0, 1], { extrapolateLeft: "clamp", extrapolateRight: "clamp" });

  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: COLORS.bg, color: COLORS.fg, fontFamily: DISPLAY }}>
      <svg width="1080" height="1920" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920" style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0 }}>
        <rect width="1080" height="1920" fill={COLORS.bg} />
        <circle cx="170" cy="260" r="220" fill={COLORS.accent} opacity="0.13" />
        <circle cx="930" cy="530" r="280" fill="#5C7CFA" opacity="0.12" />
        <path d="M70 420 H1010" stroke={COLORS.line} strokeWidth="2" />
        <path d="M70 1030 H1010" stroke={COLORS.line} strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.7" />
        <path d="M70 420 H1010" stroke={COLORS.accent} strokeWidth="8" strokeLinecap="round" opacity="0.95" pathLength="1" strokeDasharray={String(sweep) + " 1"} />
      </svg>
      <div
        style={{
          position: "absolute",
          top: 110,
          left: 74,
          right: 74,
          bottom: 520,
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: "column",
          justifyContent: "center",
          gap: 34,
          opacity: enter,
          transform: "translateY(" + ((1 - enter) * 26) + "px)",
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 18, color: COLORS.accent, fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 800, letterSpacing: 3 }}>
          <span>{eyebrow ?? "TIN"}</span>
          {props.meta ? <span style={{ color: COLORS.muted, letterSpacing: 0 }}>{props.meta}</span> : null}
        </div>
        <h1 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 82, lineHeight: 1.03, fontWeight: 900, maxWidth: 910 }}>{headline}</h1>
        <div style={{ alignSelf: "flex-start", background: COLORS.accent, color: COLORS.bg, padding: "18px 28px", borderRadius: 18, fontSize: 36, fontWeight: 900 }}>
          {props.callout}
        </div>
        {props.detail ? <p style={{ margin: 0, color: COLORS.muted, fontSize: 38, lineHeight: 1.28, maxWidth: 880 }}>{props.detail}</p> : null}
      </div>
      {props.footer ? (
        <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 74, right: 74, bottom: 455, color: COLORS.muted, fontSize: 24, letterSpacing: 2, fontWeight: 700 }}>
          {props.footer}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

export const example: P = { callout: "Một ý chính", detail: "Một câu giải thích ngắn." };
export default registerComponent<P>({
  id: "vt-statement",
  displayName: "Statement",
  promptGuide: "Opening hook or single news beat with one callout.",
  schema,
  Component: Scene,
  example,
});
`;

const METRIC = `import React from "react";
import { AbsoluteFill, interpolate, useCurrentFrame } from "remotion";
import { z } from "zod";
import { registerComponent, type SceneComponentProps } from "@motionreal/compositions";

const DISPLAY = "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif";
const COLORS = {
  bg: "#10131A",
  fg: "#F7F2E8",
  muted: "#B9B1A4",
  accent: "#FFB84D",
  ink: "#1E2430",
  teal: "#58D3C4",
};

export const schema = z.object({
  meta: z.string().optional(),
  value: z.number(),
  suffix: z.string().optional(),
  label: z.string().min(1),
  caption: z.string().optional(),
  footer: z.string().optional(),
});
type P = z.infer<typeof schema>;

const Scene: React.FC<SceneComponentProps<P>> = ({ headline, eyebrow, props }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const enter = interpolate(frame, [0, 16], [0, 1], { extrapolateLeft: "clamp", extrapolateRight: "clamp" });
  const progress = interpolate(frame, [4, 42], [0, 1], { extrapolateLeft: "clamp", extrapolateRight: "clamp" });
  const shown = Math.round(props.value * progress);
  const barWidth = 110 + progress * 690;

  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: COLORS.bg, color: COLORS.fg, fontFamily: DISPLAY }}>
      <svg width="1080" height="1920" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920" style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0 }}>
        <rect width="1080" height="1920" fill={COLORS.bg} />
        <rect x="74" y="180" width="932" height="820" rx="42" fill={COLORS.ink} />
        <rect x="130" y="760" width="820" height="48" rx="24" fill="#2F3543" />
        <rect x="130" y="760" width={barWidth} height="48" rx="24" fill={COLORS.accent} />
        <circle cx="860" cy="322" r="98" fill={COLORS.teal} opacity="0.18" />
        <circle cx="880" cy="322" r={42 + progress * 42} fill="none" stroke={COLORS.teal} strokeWidth="14" opacity="0.8" />
      </svg>
      <div
        style={{
          position: "absolute",
          top: 230,
          left: 128,
          right: 128,
          bottom: 560,
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: "column",
          justifyContent: "center",
          gap: 28,
          opacity: enter,
          transform: "scale(" + (0.96 + enter * 0.04) + ")",
          transformOrigin: "left center",
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ color: COLORS.accent, fontSize: 27, fontWeight: 900, letterSpacing: 3 }}>{eyebrow ?? "DỮ LIỆU"}{props.meta ? " / " + props.meta : ""}</div>
        <h1 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 62, lineHeight: 1.08, fontWeight: 850 }}>{headline}</h1>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "baseline", gap: 14 }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 150, lineHeight: 0.95, fontWeight: 950, color: COLORS.fg }}>{shown}</span>
          {props.suffix ? <span style={{ fontSize: 58, fontWeight: 850, color: COLORS.accent }}>{props.suffix}</span> : null}
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 42, lineHeight: 1.18, fontWeight: 800, color: COLORS.fg }}>{props.label}</div>
        {props.caption ? <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 31, lineHeight: 1.28, color: COLORS.muted, maxWidth: 780 }}>{props.caption}</p> : null}
      </div>
      {props.footer ? (
        <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 128, right: 128, bottom: 455, color: COLORS.muted, fontSize: 24, letterSpacing: 2, fontWeight: 700 }}>
          {props.footer}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

export const example: P = { value: 100, suffix: "%", label: "Nhãn số liệu" };
export default registerComponent<P>({
  id: "vt-metric",
  displayName: "Metric",
  promptGuide: "Numerical beat with one validated number from the source.",
  schema,
  Component: Scene,
  example,
});
`;

type Trans = "slide" | "fade" | "wipe" | "clockWipe" | "zoom";
const M = (id: string, component: string, eyebrow: string, headline: string, narration: string, props: Record<string, unknown>, transitionToNext?: Trans, emphasis?: "zoom") =>
  ({ id, component, eyebrow, headline, narration, props, ...(transitionToNext ? { transitionToNext } : {}), ...(emphasis ? { emphasis } : {}) });

const MANIFEST = {
  title: "__TITLE__",
  theme: { dominant: "#2F6BEF", mood: "editorial" },
  scenes: [
    M("scene-01", "vt-statement", "TIN", "Tiêu đề mở đầu", "Lời dẫn mở đầu: một câu hook trực tiếp.", { meta: "2026", callout: "Ý chính của hook", detail: "Thêm bối cảnh ngắn nếu cần.", footer: "CHỦ ĐỀ" }, "slide", "zoom"),
    M("scene-02", "vt-metric", "DỮ LIỆU", "Một con số", "Lời dẫn cho con số quan trọng.", { meta: "2026", value: 100, suffix: "%", label: "Nhãn số liệu", caption: "Chỉ dùng số liệu có trong nguồn.", footer: "DỮ LIỆU" }),
  ],
};

const FULL = { safeArea: true, alignment: true, transitions: true, clutter: true, hook: true, cta: true, audio: true, richness: true };

async function setup(): Promise<void> {
  await scaffoldVideoProject({ prompt: MANIFEST.title, projectId: ID, duration: TARGET_SECONDS, tts: { provider: "vivibe" } });
  await writeAuthoredScene(ID, "statement.tsx", STATEMENT);
  await writeAuthoredScene(ID, "metric.tsx", METRIC);
  await writeJson(projectPaths(ID).manifest, MANIFEST);
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const mode = process.argv[2] ?? "stills";
  await setup();
  const admitted = await admitProjectScenes(ID);
  if (!admitted.ok) { console.error("[vt] admission FAILED", admitted.violations); process.exitCode = 1; return; }
  if (mode === "stills") {
    const spec = await loadManifestAsSpec(ID);
    const tts = await synthesizeNarration(spec, { projectId: ID, provider: "mock" });
    const locked = lockSpec(spec, tts, { mixedNarrationSrc: tts?.mixedSrc });
    const p = projectPaths(ID);
    await writeJson(p.lock, locked);
    const entry = p.authoredDir + "\\_entry.tsx";
    await generateAuthoredEntry({ entryPath: entry, authoredFiles: admitted.files, lockJsonPath: p.lock });
    const out = await renderSceneStills(locked, p.reviewDir, { projectRoot: p.root, entryPoint: entry, remotionRoot: remotionAppRoot() });
    console.log("[vt] stills " + out.length + " frames=" + locked.durationInFrames);
  } else {
    const provider = process.argv[3] === "mock" ? "mock" : "vivibe";
    const quality = mode === "draft" ? "draft" : "full";
    const r = await renderProject(ID, { ttsProvider: provider, checklist: FULL, noCache: true, quality });
    console.log("[vt] " + quality + " mp4=" + r.mp4Path + " (~" + (r.locked.durationInFrames / r.locked.fps).toFixed(1) + "s) ok=" + r.report.ok);
    for (const i of r.report.issues) console.log("  " + i.severity + " " + i.check + " " + (i.sceneId ?? "-") + ": " + i.message);
  }
  console.log("[vt] OK");
}

main().catch((e: unknown) => { console.error("[vt] FAILED"); console.error(e); process.exitCode = 1; });
